arrangement.notes: Hook-heavy energy profile with uplifting mood using multiple sample chopping techniques as layers.

event_markers.label: Hook Onset
event_markers.reason: Start of the high-energy hook section

event_markers.label: Vocal Chops Begin
event_markers.reason: Introductory vocal chops using micro chops and stutter chops

event_markers.label: Final Hook Start
event_markers.reason: Start of the final hook with maximum energy

micro_chops.description: Very short slicing of samples for rhythmic texture

phrase_chops.description: Larger phrase slices arranged in sequence

stutter_chops.description: Repeated quick chopping for stuttering effect

sound_intent.instrumental_focus: Emphasis on chopped samples forming various layers - rhythm, melody, and vocal textures with uplifting, hook-heavy mood

designer_intent.goal: Create an uplifting trip hop instrumental with hook-heavy energy using diverse sample chop techniques across channels to build engaging textures.

presetor_intent.focus: Preserve clarity and space in chopped sample layers ensuring dynamic progression and prominence of hooks.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate drum patterns emphasizing stutter chops to create a rhythmic, hook-heavy backbone that complements the uplifting mood.

bass_generator.brief: Create supportive basslines that lock in with drum chops providing groove without overpowering the sample layers.

harmony_generator.brief: Arrange phrase chops in the chord lane to add harmonic depth and maintain uplifting tonal quality.

melody_generator.brief: Produce melodic content from micro chops that enriches hook sections and adds melodic interest.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement energy flow emphasizing hooks and managing layering of reverse and vocal chops for dynamic progression.

presetor.brief: Configure presets ensuring clean and spacious sounds for chopped samples allowing hooks to stand out.

songgps.brief: Analyze arrangement structure for energy curve optimization with focus on hook-heavy sections and smooth transitions.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Mix channels to balance chopped samples and maintain clarity and punch especially in hook sections.
